title: News, blue posts and guides, week to 2026-11-19 (model proposals)
about: Statements proposed by tools/kb/meta.py from new Wowhead Forever news, Blizzard staff forum posts and changed guide pages. Review each against its source before merging.

statements.text: Deviate Hides and Smart Drinks in Wailing Caverns are deliberately designed so one clear usually does not drop enough quest items for the whole party.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Should WoW: Forever Dungeons Let Players Complete Quests in One Run?'; review before merging

statements.text: Dungeon quest item drops now use a round-robin style distribution among party members.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Should WoW: Forever Dungeons Let Players Complete Quests in One Run?'; review before merging

statements.text: In City of Dalaran, the Alliance quest Starving Arcane lacks enough quest mobs to finish in one run. The Horde quest Source of Power has the same problem.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Should WoW: Forever Dungeons Let Players Complete Quests in One Run?'; review before merging

statements.text: Blackfathom Deeps Alliance quests Researching the Corruption and Twilight Falls usually cannot be finished in a single run.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Should WoW: Forever Dungeons Let Players Complete Quests in One Run?'; review before merging

statements.text: Developers say the level cap will not be raised, and they intend to avoid catch-up mechanics.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Catch-Up Mechanics & The Economy in WoW: Forever - But Why Tho? Interview'; review before merging

statements.text: Linken's Boots of Iron can drop from any boss in The Drowned City. They reportedly let the wearer walk on the bottom of water but move slowly on land.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Loot Ocarina of Time Boots from Drowned City in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Starting areas sell 6-slot bags. Four of them plus the 20-slot backpack give 42 slots.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Early quest bags: Wizbang's Gunnysack (8 slots) from Buzzbox 525 at level 7, and Scuffed Shipping Crate (8) from Parts and Pieces at level 9.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Deviate Hides rewards the 10-slot Deviate Hide Pack.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: The Cozy Sleeping Bag chain quest Stepping Stones (about level 14) rewards the 12-slot Old Toolbox.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: High-level quest bags: Demon Hide Sack (16 slots) from You Are Rakh'likh, Demon (45), and Hyjal Postal Satchel (18) from Top of the Post (56).
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Save Gold and Gain Bag Space by Earning Quest Rewards in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: At max level, quest experience is no longer converted to gold.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'New Max Level Weekly Quest Rewards Up to 100 Gold in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: The Booty Bay level-60 weekly is In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities. Its Undermine Satchel holds one vendor item: Gold Nugget 10g, Huge Quartz Gem 20g, Silver Necklace 40g or Gold Ring 100g.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'New Max Level Weekly Quest Rewards Up to 100 Gold in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Riverglades is designed for about levels 38–44. Players advise arriving around 40.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Completing all Riverglades quests gives roughly 4–5 levels.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Hidden Horde quest Farholde Scouting Report starts by killing Cavalry Scout Alturin. It gives 4,850 XP, but the area PvP-flags you.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Horde should bring to Riverglades: 10 Chunk of Boar Meat, 10 Heavy Weightstone, and 12 Iron Bar plus 4 Thick Leather for Key Ingredients.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Most Krol'dok Stronghold quests unlock only after the Riverglades main story. The Krol'dok Moulding chain leads to a key that opens a shortcut inside the dungeon.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Trial accounts and level-1 characters do not affect the faction-balance creation lock.
statements.origin: model proposal from '"Start Making Other Arrangements" - Josh Greenfield on Locking Character Creation on PvP Rulesets'; review before merging

statements.text: A developer confirmed that the Scarlet Enclave raid and the Ashbringer story will eventually come to Forever.
statements.origin: model proposal from "Season of Discovery's Scarlet Enclave Raid to Return in WoW: Forever"; review before merging

statements.text: Alliance can get the Might of Stormwind world buff by completing End of the Dark Horde with the Head of Rend Blackhand from Upper Blackrock Spire.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Might of Stormwind World Buff Returns in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Stormstrike now does 100% weapon damage on an 8 s cooldown.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Enhancement Shaman Class Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Mental Dexterity now converts 33/66/100% of Intellect into attack power.

statements.text: Maelstrom Weapon gives 20% less cast time and mana cost per stack at every rank. It procs 6/7/8/9/10 times per minute by rank, instead of 20 per minute.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Enhancement Shaman Class Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Maelstrom Weapon procs per swing scale with main-hand speed. At 5 points, a 3.6-speed weapon has 60% per swing and a 2.0-speed weapon 33%, so slow weapons proc more per swing.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Enhancement Shaman Class Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: The Alcaz Operative Insignia disguise toy comes from combining six Fractured Insignia. The chain starts with The Man in the Iron Chains in Alcaz Prison and continues via Moonbrook.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Secret Disguise Toy Found WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Wit's Edge is a level-60 mage sword made by using a Scroll of Wit on the Witchblade (from Darkmaster Gandling). Melee swings have a 15% chance to grant Clearcasting.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'New High Level Battle Mage Weapon Discovered in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: The Scroll of Wit is found with the mage Comprehension skill on skill-175 scrolls.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'New High Level Battle Mage Weapon Discovered in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Wearing all 5 Krol'dok Battlegear pieces (a tank plate set) turns the player into an ogre once the set bonus reaches max stacks.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'New Dungeon Set Transforms Players into an Ogre in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Dual Spec is bought at level 40 for 50 gold.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Learning Dual Spec Can Trigger Empty Action Bars When Logging Out in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Known bug: after learning Dual Spec, some action bars can randomly reset on logout. Players use the Myslot addon to restore them.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Learning Dual Spec Can Trigger Empty Action Bars When Logging Out in WoW: Forever'; review before merging

statements.text: Krol'dok Stronghold has 5 Alliance quests and 4 Horde quests.
statements.origin: model proposal from "Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold: New Dungeon in WoW: Forever"; review before merging

statements.text: Nar'gurk mind-converts a random player, and the party must bring that player to 50% health to break it.
statements.origin: model proposal from "Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold: New Dungeon in WoW: Forever"; review before merging

statements.text: Twilight Grunts are the most dangerous Krol'dok trash: their Bladestorm hits everyone within 8 yards, and multiple Grunts stack quickly.

statements.text: Twilight Commander Zarmok uses AoE Rending Whirl and enrages at 30% health.

statements.text: The Honored 10% riding discount does not work for Skyborne. Their trainer has no faction, so Journeyman Riding stays 1,000g.
statements.origin: model proposal from "Skyborne Don't Have Reputation Discount for Mounts in WoW: Forever"; review before merging

statements.text: After Zephras Isle, Skyborne faction reputation comes only from repeatable runecloth turn-ins: 150 reputation per 60 Runecloth.
statements.origin: model proposal from "Skyborne Don't Have Reputation Discount for Mounts in WoW: Forever"; review before merging

statements.text: Since the 13 Nov hotfix, diminishing returns apply to stuns both ways between players and creatures (a bug had removed them).
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Many Fixes to Dungeons, Quests, Enemies and Classes - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 13, 2026'; review before merging

statements.text: Wild Growth can no longer be cast while moving, and its healing coefficient was doubled to 6.6% (was 3.3%).
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Many Fixes to Dungeons, Quests, Enemies and Classes - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 13, 2026'; review before merging

statements.text: Frost Nova now breaks on damage from procs and from Blizzard, so do not Blizzard targets you have rooted.

statements.text: Judgement of Command counts as a melee attack and triggers on-hit effects; every other Judgement counts as a ranged attack.
statements.origin: model proposal from 'Many Fixes to Dungeons, Quests, Enemies and Classes - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 13, 2026'; review before merging

statements.text: Judgements count as ranged attacks: they use the Paladin's ranged hit chance and do not trigger melee item or effect procs.

statements.text: Windfury Totem can proc from any melee ability, but off-hand strikes from abilities such as Whirlwind or Mutilate cannot; only their main-hand strike can.

statements.text: Honor no longer decides rank. Rank points come from daily and weekly sources, weekly battlegrounds, Season Journey quests and some world PvP events (Gurubashi).

statements.text: Low ranks give rare-quality PvP gear. From Rank 8 it can be upgraded to epic, and Rank 14 unlocks epic weapons that match raid gear.

statements.text: The weekly Season Journey quest is the biggest source of rank points and has catch-up. Max rank is expected around the middle of a season.
